newsitem.title: INDIA: Snag-hit India National Exchange resumes trade.
newsitem.headline: Snag-hit India National Exchange resumes trade.

text.p: India's snag-hit National Stock Exchange (NSE) on Friday resumed trade at 1615 hours (1045 GMT), dealers said.
An NSE message flashed to its members said trading will continue till 1715 hours (1145 GMT).
Earlier, technical problems forced the NSE to halt trading at about 1400 hours, traders said.
The NSE 50-stock index was trading 22.05 points, or 2.12 percent, higher at 1,060.15 in latest deals.
